messages:
support-ops: FYI customer 'acme-health' (tenant acme-123) opened a ticket: their SIEM missed ~25 minutes of audit events (2026-03-15T02:00Z -> 02:25Z). They see manifests but several referenced blobs are empty/0 bytes when they pull from our export bucket.

support-ops: Customer pasted output: 
```
$ aws s3 ls s3://redwood-exports/acme-123/2026/03/15/02/ --recursive
2026-03-15 02:05:10        0 manifest-20260315-020510.json.gz
2026-03-15 02:05:10        0 chunk-01.gz
2026-03-15 02:07:30     4096 manifest-20260315-020730.json.gz
```

alyssa: Can you also share the manifest JSON? need the blob keys to cross-check their SIEM ingester logs.

support-ops: They sent a manifest snippet: `{"blobs":["acme-123/2026/03/15/02/chunk-01.gz","acme-123/2026/03/15/02/chunk-02.gz"]}`

marie: Pulled forwarder logs for that export job. Export completed at 2026-03-15T02:05:10Z but re-encrypt worker logged a decrypt error shortly after. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T02:06:45Z ERROR reencrypt-worker decrypt failed: HSM_KEY_NOT_FOUND alias=\"alias/audit-rotate-20260315\" rotation_id=rot-92bf
```

dan: That matches DLQ entries I just inspected. ~30 DLQ messages for acme-123 with "HSM alias mismatch / key_not_found". I exported DLQ to s3://staging-audit-dlq/acme-123/2026-03-15/ for reprocessing.

sec-bot: Automated: HSM rotation executed by ops@redwood at 2026-03-15T02:03:10Z (rotation_id: rot-92bf). Alias swap observed for audit-encryptor.

alyssa: Customer is asking if we can replay missing events into their SIEM and what the ETA is. They care about non-duplication and retention compliance.

marie: Two recovery paths:
- If ops retained the previous HSM key material (backup/unwrap token), we can decrypt DLQ payloads and rewrap with current alias, then republish exports.
- If key material is unrecoverable, we must reconstruct events from the write-ahead log (WAL) if within retention. WAL has 7-day retention for audit writes; reconstruction is slower and may have gaps.

dan: Short mitigation I can ship: decrypt-fallback canary that attempts the legacy alias when decrypt fails and writes rewrapped blobs to a canary export bucket. I'll limit it to 1 tenant and rate-limit to avoid overload.

alyssa: Customer agreed to a backfill window tonight (22:00Z) if we can ensure safe dedupe. They want a verification plan for no duplicate alerts in SIEM.

marie: Verification + compliance plan:
1) support-ops: freeze any manual replay attempts from customer side for the window (owner: alyssa).
2) ops: confirm whether prior HSM key backup exists and provide access token for rewrap (owner: ops).
3) dan: deploy decrypt-fallback canary at 20:30Z in us-west-2 with strict rate limiting and logging (owner: dan).
4) marie: run rewrap job against DLQ using legacy alias if available; otherwise run WAL reconstruct job and generate canonical chunk files (owner: marie).
5) dan: publish new manifests to export bucket, mark them as replayed and include replay_id to avoid SIEM duplicates (owner: dan).
6) support-ops: inform customer when we start and provide a checksum list so they can verify ingest (owner: alyssa).

support-ops: Example rewrap command for staging (demo):
```
$ audit-rewrap --dlq s3://staging-audit-dlq/acme-123/2026-03-15/ \
  --legacy-alias alias/audit-legacy-20260315 \
  --out s3://redwood-exports/acme-123/2026/03/15/replayed/ \
  --add-metadata replay_id=INC-2026-0423
```

dan: I'll also add a replay header in the manifest and set manifest.replay=true so downstream SIEM connectors can dedupe by replay_id and timestamp. Dashboards to watch: /dashboards/audit-forwarder-errors and /dashboards/export-throughput.

alyssa: Compliance asked for an incident record and retention sign-off before we proceed. They also want the chain-of-custody note for events rewrapped with legacy keys.

marie: Done: created incident INC-2026-0423 and added compliance tag. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0423. CC compliance, ops, support.

sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0423 by marie.

dan: I'll post the canary deploy link once up. Planning to throttle rewrap to 10MB/s for the tenant to avoid downstream storms.

support-ops: Customer told to hold on manual replays. They asked if this triggers any SLA credits given gaps; we told them we'll review after the incident closes.

alyssa: I'll keep customer updated and post completion + checksum file when done. :thumbsup:

marie: Next steps: ops to confirm key backup by 18:00Z, dan to prep canary, marie to validate DLQ payload integrity and start rewrap if key available.

support-ops: Noted. Will follow up on the customer ticket and update the incident playbook.

dan: Canary deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/canary/rep-242987-1 (posted once validate).

alyssa: Thanks team.
